all_text_content:
Verse of the Day
But if not, be it known unto thee, O king, that we will not serve thy gods, nor worship the golden image which thou hast set up.
Daniel 3:18
Quote of the Day
"As we “seek … first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness,” we follow Jesus Christ and the Lord’s prophet willingly, obediently, joyfully."
Elder Gerrit W. Gong | 1 Apr 2026General Conference
